reports.notes: Born-digital typed form, dotloop-signed (signature verification banner 'dtlp.us/hJgj-FYBE-0IZc' at the top of pages 1 and 3; dotloop stamp '10/29/24 1:53 PM MDT'). Not redacted - address, phone and email are all printed; only the city is recorded here per package privacy rules. Office field reads 'Utah County Commissioner Seat C' (index.csv 'County Commission Seat C' - agrees). Candidate name on the page is 'Skyler M. Beltran'; index.csv carries 'Skyler Beltran' (middle initial only). Box A is written '$0' with no cents. DATE DISCREPANCY within the filing: the cover page's 'Date of Report' and signature date both read 10/28/2024, while the summary page's own 'Date of Report' box reads 10/29/2024 - report_date takes the cover value, the summary value is recorded here. Page 3 is Schedule A (8 itemized contributions, page subtotal 8,544.23, 'Total Contributions Received 13,894.23') - NOT transcribed per this tranche's totals-only scope; its stated total agrees with Box B. Red clerk 'RECEIVED OCT 30 2024' stamp on the cover (clerk markup). index.csv carries a blank reporting_period; the page checks 'Seven days preceding the General Election'.

contributions.detail: TWO Schedule A sheets, each gated on its OWN printed page subtotal first (§L2 — a sheet is only a closable unit if it prints its own subtotal, and both do). p2: 15 rows sum to 500 + 100 + 300 + 50 + 2000 + 500 + 100 + 250 + 100 + 250 + 250 + 300 + 50 + 500 + 100 = 5,350.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 5350'. p3: 8 rows sum to 100 + 5000 + 100 + 100 + 200 + 40 + 3000 + 4.23 = 8,544.23 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 8,544.23'. Multi-sheet total 5,350.00 + 8,544.23 = 13,894.23 = the schedule's own grand-total footer on p3 = the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B. Box C YTD also prints 13,894.23 (single cycle report) and is NOT summed as an increment. ⚠ THE GRAND-TOTAL FOOTER ON p2 IS A SUPERSEDED FIGURE, handled per the handwritten-correction rule: it prints a typed 'Total Contributions Received $ 5350' STRUCK THROUGH with '$13,894.23' handwritten beside it and initialled 'SMB'. The handwritten correction over the struck typed value GOVERNS, and it agrees with p3's footer and with Box B. Ladder: F = A + B = 0 + 13,894.23 = 13,894.23 and close = F - D = 13,894.23 - 3,849.95 = 10,044.28, exactly as printed.

Both conventions therefore give the same sums and both close at 13,894.23 / 3,849.95. Tested per §G1 on this filing rather than inherited from its two Beltran siblings.
itemized.escalation_note: Sixteen 900 dpi tight --value crops: on each of the five schedule pages a first-row proof, a last-transcribed-row proof and a one-past control, plus one re-take. THE RE-TAKE IS WORTH RECORDING because it is exactly the defect the controls exist to catch: the first p3 last-row crop was taken at band [51.98,56.39] and rendered an EMPTY cell — an off-by-one in my own indexing, since p3's eight entries end at band 8 = [47.59,51.98]. Re-cropped at the correct band it rendered '$4.23'. The stored frame is the corrected one and the row indices in the record follow it. On the three FULL grids (p2, p4, p5) the one-past control had to be taken OUTSIDE the grid per §J6, and each rendered that sheet's printed page subtotal ('$ 5350', '$ 2458.67', '$ $810.64') rather than an entry — which simultaneously proves no §F1 trap-5 row hides below the last rule and independently re-reads the subtotal each side was gated on. No figure was corrected.

So two form revisions and three mastheads sit inside one report — §L6's 'two masthead vintages can alternate sheet by sheet' extended to three — and the two v. 4.20 sheets are measurably different in grid geometry from the v. 12.23 sheets, which is why each page carries its own frame. Handwritten corrections over struck typed values GOVERN (CHUNK_BRIEF §7), and here they are independently confirmed: the corrected 13,894.23 and 3,849.95 equal the multi-sheet sums of the printed page subtotals AND equal Boxes B and D.
